title: Max Points on a Line
inputFormat: Implement maxPointsOnALine(points). Receive an array of distinct [x, y] integer coordinate pairs.
outputFormat: Return the maximum number of input points on a single straight line, including vertical and horizontal lines.

visuals.title: Count points sharing one line
